resources.string: Local encrypted archive of text and downloaded originals before deletion, media expiry and edits. Off by default; applies to future events for this account. Up to 2,000 snapshots and 128 MiB of attachments; 32 MiB per file. Oldest entries are removed first. Undownloaded attachments and earlier deletions cannot be recovered. Disabling keeps the archive. Nothing is sent to another server.
